thread:
Jamie L: Hey team — quick sync re: the rwinf-504 spike we paged for earlier. Ops confirms mitigation completed and customer-facing errors cleared. We should schedule a post-incident review to capture timeline, owners, and follow-ups. Who can facilitate next week?

Samir (oncall): I can facilitate. Monday or Tuesday mornings PT work best for me. Not available Wed/Thu. :wave:

Priya R: thanks Samir — appreciated. Can you also run through the mitigation timeline during the session? We still need to confirm whether the KV cache rollover contributed.

Samir (oncall): yep — will cover timeline + blobs of logs we collected. I might need Alex to walk me through the kernel/quantization changes that were deployed.

Alex P: I can join and explain the rollout. I don't want to be the primary facilitator though — can co-facilitate with Samir.

Marta (support): Heads up — two impacted customers opened tickets (CS-7842, CS-7849). They'll want the summary and action items. Can we include CS on the attendee list?

Jamie L: Yes, include Marta and the CS owners. Suggested attendee list: oncall rotation, eng-runtime, eng-ml (Alex), eng-sre (Priya), product, and CS. I can take the calendar lead.

Incident Bot: Automated incident summary attached: rwinf-504 spike; pages at 2055014400; mitigation entered at 2055014800; alerts cleared at 2055015600. Link: https://incidents.internal/rwinf-504 :link:

Priya R: Proposed agenda (short): 1) TL;DR and customer impact (5m) 2) Timeline & mitigation (15m) 3) Root cause hypotheses (15m) 4) Action items & owners (10m) — total 45m. Add any other items?

Samir (oncall): Looks good. I propose Monday 16:00 UTC (which is 09:00 PT) — works for US/EU overlap. If that works, I'll run and keep to the agenda.

Alex P: Monday 16:00 UTC works for me.

Marta (support): Works for CS folks — please add a short pre-read with the timeline so CS can prep customer-facing language.

Jamie L: Action list for scheduling: 
- Jamie L -> create calendar invite (include Zoom + incident doc link) (due: today)
- Priya R -> prepare timeline + logs excerpt and add to doc (due: before meeting)
- Alex P -> prepare quick deployment diff + what changed in kernel selection (due: before meeting)
- Samir (oncall) -> prepare facilitation notes + run the meeting (owner)
- Marta (support) -> draft customer summary template post-review

Samir (oncall): I'll also add a short icebreaker: confirm whether any ongoing latency regressions remain. If we see anything during the week, flag it in this thread. :eyes:

Priya R: Noted — I'll add a short section in the doc about KV cache rollover observations and token distribution.

Jamie L: Invite sent to the attendee list and CS owners. Zoom link and pre-read attached in the calendar event. Ping me if you didn't get it. :calendar:

Alex P: Got it. I'll DM Samir a couple of charts to reference during the meeting.

Marta (support): Thanks. I'll queue the two customer tickets and mark them pending until we have the post-incident summary.

Incident Bot: Reminder scheduled — post-incident review for rwinf-504 on 2055021600 UTC (15 minutes before). Reminder will ping #incidents and attendees.

Samir (oncall): Thanks all. I'll shepherd the agenda and capture action items live. If anyone wants to add pre-read content, drop it in the incident doc (link in the invite). :thumbsup:

Jamie L: Closing the loop here — facilitator assigned (Samir), invite sent, CS notified, owners for pre-work assigned. If anything changes, update this thread.

Priya R: One last thing — let's track the mitigation RCA and a test plan to ensure the KV cache rollover doesn't reoccur. I'll create a follow-up ticket after the review.
